items.caption: A modern rendering of 牛 in Shuowen seal-script style, showing a later seal form of the character.
items.alt: Black seal-script 牛, with a central vertical stroke, two curved upper branches, and a horizontal cross-stroke, on a white background.
items.selection_reason: This identified seal-style form illustrates the character’s graphic history. It does not establish the appearance or date of earlier inscriptional forms.

limitations.text: This image is a modern vector rendering, not a dated artifact. The listed form classes do not date individual specimens or establish the earliest securely dated 牛 graph.
